# CANDIDATE: BULLISH_RECLAIM_RIDE_THE_RIBBON_WALKFORWARD

**Filed:** 2026-06-27
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger_branch

## Hypothesis

The BULLISH_RECLAIM_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup has a positive edge when SPY reclaims a defined support level and the EMA ribbon flips bullish. We hypothesize that this edge can be captured by riding the EMA ribbon as a dynamic trailing stop.

## Mechanism

The mechanism involves the following steps:

1. Identify a defined support level (e.g., premarket low, ascending trendline, prior horizontal support).
2. Wait for the EMA ribbon to flip bullish (Fast EMA > Pivot EMA > Slow EMA).
3. Enter a long position (buy calls) when the first morning bar (≤ 10:30 ET) continues in-trend (breakout or pullback).
4. Set a chart stop at the reclaimed level + $0.50 buffer.
5. Set a chandelier profit-lock at +5% favor, trailing 0.15 off the high-water mark.
6. Set a premium stop at -50% (catastrophe cap).
7. Scale out at TP1 (+50% premium) and move the runner stop to breakeven.
